column2: Send out four pulses. Up, up, up, down. Something out there bounces them back.
To find the echo, slide a copy along what came back, and multiply the pulses that line up.
Pulses pointing the same way agree, and add a block. Opposite ways disagree, and take one away.
Lined up exactly, all four agree. A score of four, right where the echo is.
One step off, three pairs line up. Two agree, one disagrees. A score of one, where nothing is.
Slide all the way, and ghosts appear on both sides, a quarter the size of the echo.
With more than one pulse, every pattern leaves ghosts. So send a second. Up, up, down, up.
It leaves ghosts too, the same size, at the same shifts. What if we add the two rows, shift by shift?
Every ghost meets its opposite, and they cancel. Only the echo is left, twice as tall.
Two bad echoes, and together, not a single ghost.
But the guarantee needs the same scene for both sends. Move the echo one step between them, and ghosts return.
